evaluation.checkpoint_policy: independent minima of validation structure and total; whole epoch states
evaluation.pairing: same protocol, fraction, seed and checkpoint selection
evaluation.standard_deviation: sample std ddof=1; N/A with fewer than two seeds
evaluation.symmetry_validation: exact algebraic symmetry; float32 checks allow atol=1e-7, rtol=1e-6 (baseline roundoff)

fusion.dropout_location: once after G00/even-G05 fusion, before all structure heads; none in global branch
fusion.g05_summary: unchanged masked mean/max/std; same g05_encoder as global sign
fusion.shared_encoder_note: Full model G05 encoder receives both structure and global-sign gradients; global loss has no path into G00, structure heads or structure_context

input_policy.global_sign: masked G05 only; odd in V
masked G05 only; odd in V

physics.full_fraction_definition: all stored candidate sensors, not necessarily the full grid
physics.matching: exact 120-permutation minimum of position MSE + magnitude MSE + sign cost
physics.metric_alignment: same joint structure assignment as the loss; no G05/global-sign cost
physics.missing_g05: global sign unidentifiable; absolute-sign metrics are N/A
physics.partial_g05_definition: fixed nested sensor prefixes in every sample
physics.position_normalization: train-only per-axis statistics pooled over all charge slots
physics.relative_sign_loss: conditional NLL over 16 valid patterns, divided by 5

structure.global_sign_metrics_note: Global-sign and absolute-sign metrics are secondary diagnostics: structure selection does not optimize global-sign performance; training still uses the unchanged total loss.
structure.selection_note: One complete epoch state; first epoch wins ties; no component composition

total.global_sign_metrics_note: Total selection includes global-sign loss only with observed G05 and nonzero global-sign weight.
total.selection_note: One complete epoch state; first epoch wins ties; no component composition

training.early_stopping_policy: reset patience when either validation total or structure improves; no test metrics
